title: Verificación: Strix Halo (Ryzen AI Max+ 395) NPU ignored by llama.cpp + memory partitioning limits confirmed by user
summary: Claim revisado: AMD Strix Halo offers strong local AI potential with 50 TOPS NPU and up to 128GB unified memory. Evidencia: Detailed user report on Ryzen AI Max+ 395: llama.cpp does not use NPU (everything on GPU), image/video gen 'painfully slow' (5x slower than owner's DGX Spark), memory config maxes GPU at ~96GB of 128GB LPDDR5X (requires reboot to change). 'AMD Chat' useless.. Caveat editorial: Software ecosystem lag is real; NPU underutilized, memory access restricted vs NVIDIA unified approach, gen workloads lag significantly.. Reproducibilidad: high - specific hardware model, exact limitations observed, comparison to another device owned by same user.
